signal: CAI Software acquired Mar-Kov (Feb 2025) and merged with Print ePS to form three manufacturing-ERP divisions (Oct 2025)

email.subject1: a signal play for CAI Software
email.body1:
Max, saw CAI acquired Mar-Kov and then merged with Print ePS into three operating divisions.

That kind of expansion opens far more manufacturing accounts than an inside-sales team can personally cover before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for CAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Max, quick follow-up for CAI.

After a merger and acquisition, the cross-sell and new-logo list expands faster than headcount can. Most teams never map how many meetings they actually need to book to hit the combined number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings CAI needs across the three divisions this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Max, last bit of proof for CAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how CAI's reply rate likely compares to other manufacturing-ERP vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Max, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating a merger and an acquisition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a manufacturing-ERP motion? I'll tailor it to CAI either way.
